display_name: 时频跨恢复器七景测试
description: 冻结 DURA 与独立直接恢复器，使用源域配对 IQ 训练 3576004 参数时频联合残差网络，自动七景测试。
authorization: User requests continued novel and DURA-combinable Phase1 restoration research, F-free/TX-label-free source training, automatic seven-view test and truth-last score.

code.environment: N607 physical GPU7 FP32 TF32 off deterministic source training; CPU ground two threads

data.representation: Frozen DURA/direct and time-frequency source-trained refiner with frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL
data.physical_ids_ref: 168000 fixed Phase1 Main split ground physical records in each of seven views
data.tx_sets_ref: No target labels, clean pair, or target fitting during inference; labels only after all seven predictions

roles.L_s: source IQ training only, TX hidden
roles.U_s: source IQ training only, TX hidden
roles.test: fixed Phase1 ground IQ, truth last

data.validation_ref: Seven fixed predictions precede independent truth-last scoring
data.support_query_ref: Phase1 original fixed cross_rx126000 and cross_both42000; no support
data.leo_config_ref: R07 2.462 GHz source views and Phase1 six fixed practical test views
data.target_panel: 168000 Phase1 physical records x seven views
data.actual_training_labels: Recovery training uses paired source IQ only; no F outputs, F weights, TX labels, V or target. Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL only after recovery checkpoint frozen.
data.augmentation: Fixed pre-existing Phase1 ground test simulated seven views

permissions.query_use: Fixed per-record Phase1 IQ only after source training; no target fit, truth only after seven-view predictions
permissions.claim_scope: Single-seed repeatedly observed Phase1 simulated ground test; not independent blind or real satellite

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen DURA v1 and F-free direct final20; fresh 3576004-parameter time-frequency residual refiner initialized to half mix
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Same legal Phase1 source role/physical split; source direct parent F-free and final20; 17632 gate fit IDs disjoint from parent 32768 and 672 pilot
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen source-only direct checkpoint with exact verified source fit; gate learns from legal parent-unseen L_s/U_s IQ
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed final epoch 20 regardless of source or target result

execution.gpu_policy: GPU7: >=4096 MiB free and fewer than 3 total compute apps; at most one this-task worker; preserve other owners
execution.stop_rule: Stop exact owner only for source contract/role mismatch, nonfinite computation, incorrect checkpoint, target leakage or unrecoverable technical failure. Preserve all artifacts.

metric_names: raw clean gap in pp and relative percent
metrics_plan.scorer_ref: independent CPU subprocess ground score after seven complete predictions

rows.purpose: Train unconstrained IQ corrections from source signals and two frozen experts
rows.seed_notes: Refiner model 2026110830; source fit 2026110611 inherited parent; order 2026110831; fixed evaluation 2026092701.
rows.scenario: clean and six practical Phase1 Main split views
rows.budget_ref: fixed final20 source refiner; 168000 Phase1 records x seven views; predictions before truth

notes: Source L_s/U_s IQ only: no TX labels, F weights/outputs, V or target used for G training.
Time/frequency residual branches start at zero so initial output is fixed half mixture; learned IQ correction is unrestricted, not a scalar blend.
17632 direct-parent-unseen source IDs, fixed source epochs 21/22/23, normalized waveform MSE + 0.02 DURA change penalty; AdamW lr .0003, batch128, 20 epochs fixed final.
Five focused tests and independent P0/P1 review passed; first real-source no-query smoke checks both branches and gradients; all seven Phase1 predictions precede independent scoring.
Motivation includes previously explored source pilot; target history has been observed, resulting test is not a new independent blind study.
